run_visualizer_server: run a flask server to visualize OpenEvolve evolution data from a checkpoint directory
export_static_html: export a static HTML visualization of evolution data to a specified output directory
find_latest_checkpoint: find the most recent checkpoint folder in a given base directory by modification time
load_evolution_data: load evolution nodes and edges from a checkpoint folder including metadata and program files
sanitize_program_for_visualization: sanitize program metrics by replacing infinite or NaN values with null for JSON serialization
